Team Supreme was a Swedish HPW QuakeWorld TDM clan. Most notably, it was one of Swedens absolute last HPW clans, as the ADSL connection was becoming the norm. This clan played for the last few months of the golden dial-up modem era, basically playing and practising against the same team and players every night, since the playerbase was miniscule. Team Supreme played TopGun almost every night up until the point where everyone had gotten ADSL, where the team reformed into [[Clan One]].
